I have five years of experience, primary schooling, and a six-person household, so I will keep the plan simple, stable, and manageable rather than trying anything complicated. Because I have well irrigation, I will rely on that to avoid moisture stress at key stages. I will use improved seed because I want more reliable emergence and yield than traditional seed, but I will avoid pushing inputs too hard since that raises cost and risk. I will plough before planting because I want a clean seedbed and better rooting. I will apply a moderate fertilizer rate to support growth without overdoing it, and I will plan several pesticide sprays because cotton usually needs pest control through the season. My target is a steady, realistic cotton yield rather than chasing a risky high yield.
